plainTranslation: A's growth meets B's love and values. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their optimism lands on your affection, and the bond feels generous and warm. Easy enjoyment, with a risk of overpromising or overindulging. Enjoy the abundance without letting it inflate the promises.
tension: The challenge is remembering that growth requires honesty as well as positivity. It is easy to focus on the good and overlook what needs attention. You may avoid difficult conversations, assume things will work themselves out, or mistake comfort for progress.
advice: Enjoy what is good, but do not ignore what needs attention. This connection works best when appreciation and responsibility are both present.
